t1.generated_sql:
-- 경고 이상 알람 이력을 최근 발생 순으로 20건 조회
SELECT
  a.id AS alarm_id,
  a.ctime AS occurrence_time,
  a.alarmseverity AS severity,
  a.conditionid AS condition_id,
  a.currentalarmstatus AS status,
  a.resource_id AS resource_id,
  r.name AS resource_name,
  r.hostname AS resource_hostname
FROM polestar.cmm_alarm a
JOIN polestar.cmm_resource r
  ON a.resource_id = r.id
WHERE r.resource_type = 'server.Server'
  AND r.dtime IS NULL
  AND a.ctime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.ctime DESC
LIMIT 20;
